title: PD 1096 Rule VII: TGFA, AMBF, and Location Controls
subject: Building Laws / National Building Code

questions.stem: Under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 704.1(a), which site condition is required before a building may be constructed?

options.A: It must adjoin or directly access a public space, yard, or street on at least one side.
options.B: It must be surrounded by streets on all sides.
options.C: It must have no side yard if firewalls are used.
options.D: It must use the maximum TGFA before any location check.

rationale.correct: Section 704.1(a) states that the building must adjoin or have direct access to a public space, yard, or street on at least one side.

distractors.B: Section 704.1(a) requires at least one side, not all sides.
distractors.C: Firewall/setback issues are separate controls; they do not replace the Section 704.1(a) location rule.
distractors.D: TGFA comes under Section 705; it does not replace the Section 704.1(a) threshold location rule.

rationale.takeaway: Check Section 704.1(a) location/property access before doing area arithmetic.

questions.source_locator: PD 1096, 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 704.1(a), PDF p.81.

questions.stem: A question asks for Allowable Maximum Total Gross Floor Area. Which abbreviation should control the computation?

rationale.correct: TGFA means Total Gross Floor Area. Section 705.1-705.2 governs allowable floor areas and TGFA limitation.

distractors.A: AMBF is the building footprint, not total floor area.
distractors.C: FSEC is a Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance term, not the Rule VII area metric.
distractors.D: NPCP is the plumbing code, not the NBCP floor-area control.

rationale.takeaway: Do not swap TGFA and AMBF; both appear in development-control questions.

questions.source_locator: PD 1096, 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 705.1-705.2, PDF p.83.

questions.stem: For eaves over required windows under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 704.1(c), what minimum distance from side and rear property lines is stated?

rationale.correct: Section 704.1(c) states that eaves over required windows shall not be less than 750 mm from side and rear property lines.

distractors.A: 300 mm is not the Section 704.1(c) value for eaves over required windows.
distractors.B: 500 mm is not the cited value.
distractors.D: 1200 mm is not the Section 704.1(c) eaves-over-required-windows distance.

rationale.takeaway: When the question prompt says eaves over required windows, answer the Section 704.1(c) value, not a general setback memory.

questions.source_locator: PD 1096, 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 704.1(c), PDF p.81.
